## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Content quality gate

If this PR changes user-facing copy, confirm every applicable item below before merge:

- [ ] The page matches one clear primary user intent.
- [ ] The content is semantically complete for that intent.
- [ ] I checked the current Ubersuggest SERP for the primary query.
- [ ] I reviewed the strongest relevant competitors and added genuine information gain.
- [ ] I checked current first-party documentation for model-specific claims.
- [ ] The page is easy to scan on desktop and mobile.
- [ ] The copy reads as native-quality US English for a global audience.
- [ ] I removed known grammar, spelling, capitalization, and punctuation errors.
- [ ] I rewrote avoidable passive voice into active voice.
- [ ] I removed repetition, filler, keyword stuffing, and awkward exact-match SEO phrases.
- [ ] Examples, caveats, FAQs, and comparisons are included only when they help the user.
- [ ] Internal links point to genuinely related next tasks.
- [ ] Metadata accurately describes the page.
- [ ] No claim implies PromptVera uses AI where the current tool uses browser-side deterministic logic.
- [ ] No claim guarantees model behavior, ranking, output quality, availability, ownership, or commercial rights.

See docs/content-quality-standard.md for the full release gate.

## Validation

- [ ] npm run typecheck
- [ ] npm run build
